entities.summary: Koulikoro is a town and urban commune in Mali. The capital of the Koulikoro Region, Koulikoro is located on banks of the Niger River, 59 kilometres (37 mi) downstream from Mali's capital Bamako. Koulikoro is a human settlement in West Africa. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
